findings.title: ensureSubscribed useEffect spliced mid-hook-sequence
findings.detail: The new usePushSubscription()/useEffect pair is inserted between useDriverMe/useMySummary and the useGoOnline hooks. Hook order is stable so no React-rules violation; purely a readability nit that push-wiring interleaves the data hooks.
findings.recommendation: Optional: group the push useEffect with the component's other effects. Not blocking.

findings.title: Board red icon only appears after an order-detail cache load (cross-lane data gap)
findings.detail: showFailedSms reads the ['orders','detail',id] cache via useQuery enabled:false (reactive, no refetch storm - correct per web-performance#query-keys). But OrderSummaryDto (the list projection feeding the board) carries no hasFailedSms/notifications, so the icon is absent until that order's detail is loaded once (drawer/assign-picker populates the cache). At-a-glance-across-the-whole-board needs a Lane A list-DTO flag not present in A6.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the conductor's planned post-laneA5 fold (add OrderSummaryDto.hasFailedSms + card reads it). Acceptable to ship B5a as-is; see red_icon_verdict. Not blocking.

summary: B1+B2 web changes are clean and conventions-compliant; no CRITICAL/HIGH findings; nothing blocks merge. SW injectManifest switch is correct: custom src/sw.ts precaches __WB_MANIFEST, renders {title,body,url,tag,priority}, notificationclick focuses/opens url, OfferToDriver (priority high / tag offer) sets requireInteraction:true. The advisor-caught generateSW regression is FIXED - NavigationRoute(createHandlerBoundToURL('/index.html')) with denylist [/^/api/,/^/hubs/] preserves offline deep-route reload (spec 11); SKIP_WAITING message listener present for registerType:'prompt'; devOptions.enabled:false keeps the SW out of dev/Playwright; no /api or /hubs runtime caching introduced. Subscription wiring is feature-detected (jsdom-safe no-op), POSTs on grant, DELETEs on unsubscribe, VAPID key read from import.meta.env via isolated pushConfig (no hardcoded key), pure vapidKeyToApplicationServerKey (test asserts decoded bytes + url-safe -_ substitution, genuinely exercises the conversion); driver mandatory (DriverHomePage useEffect) + customer-after-first-order (PushPrompt accept->ensureSubscribed) both wired. B2 NotificationsSection renders status->tone/label (Czech, role=status not color-alone, Europe/Prague time, failed item shows provider error); axe test uses the preconfigured shared/test/axe helper + toHaveNoViolations. Failed-SMS red icon on OrderCard with i18n aria-label; notificationStatus.ts correctly promoted to src/shared/notifications (consumed by both features/orders and features/board - no cross-feature import); OrderCard reads detail cache via useQuery enabled:false (reactive, not a board refetch storm). B2 Settings SMS panel VERIFIED in smsCostDisplay.ts + FleetTab.tsx: estimatedCost = count*unitCost (integer x integer, no float), formatCzk uses Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ', currency CZK, 0 fraction digits) per web-react-style#dates-and-money, near>=90%/over>=100% with cap-disabled (<=0) degrading to ok, cap warning rendered with role='alert', and the whole panel hidden unless all three fields (smsSentThisMonth/smsUnitCostCzk/smsMonthlyCapCzk) are present - matching the handoff claim. client.ts extended additively (not forked); OrderNotificationDto single-sourced in shared and re-exported; FleetSettingsDto extended additive-optional. i18n cs/en parity verified programmatically (694/694 keys, zero drift). No tsbuildinfo staged; only web/ files in this lane's scope (api/ files belong to the concurrent Lane A and are out of scope).
red_icon_verdict: ACCEPTABLE for B5a - the conductor's plan to fold the fix post-laneA5 is the RIGHT call, NOT a blocker. The web side is wired correctly (reactive, zero-fetch cache read, and the drawer NotificationsSection always shows failed-SMS on open). The only limitation is at-a-glance coverage on the board: the card icon shows only after an order's detail is loaded, because A6 added `notifications` to OrderDetailDto but not a `hasFailedSms` flag to the LIST OrderSummaryDto. Full at-a-glance requires a Lane A list-DTO addition that is out of B5a's scope and cannot be done purely in web. The B2 AC as written ('OrderCard shows a red icon when the order has at least one Failed Sms notification') is satisfied for any order whose detail is in cache. Recommend the conductor track OrderSummaryDto.hasFailedSms as a follow-up after laneA5; it does not gate this merge.
